en.title: Patricia Summersett Celebrates 7 Years as Princess Zelda's Voice
en.summary: The iconic voice behind Princess Zelda reflects on her nearly decade-long tenure as the royal heroine. As the franchise nears its 40th anniversary, fans eagerly await her next royal decree.
en.body:
For nearly a decade, one voice has become synonymous with the brave and regal Princess Zelda: **Patricia Summersett**. Since stepping into the role in 2017 with the groundbreaking **The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild**, Summersett has lent her voice to Nintendo's most beloved princess across multiple acclaimed titles, including **Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity** and the critically lauded **The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom**. Her tenure marks a significant chapter in the franchise's rich history, especially as the series itself approaches its 40th anniversary.

Summersett, born March 15, 1982, is a Canadian-American actress whose performance as Zelda has earned her significant recognition. Her work in **Tears of the Kingdom** even garnered a nomination for Best Supporting Performer at the Golden Joystick Awards in 2023. This consistent, powerful performance has been instrumental in shaping the character for a new generation of players, many of whom first experienced Zelda through her voice in **Breath of the Wild**. The introduction of voice acting in a mainline Zelda game was a monumental shift for the series, and Summersett's portrayal proved that the princess could indeed speak, adding new layers of depth and emotional resonance to her character.

## A Royal Legacy in Voice

Fans have embraced Summersett's interpretation of Princess Zelda, appreciating her ability to convey both vulnerability and strength. In an interview, Summersett discussed her long-standing connection to the character, noting her extensive work on the franchise. Her voice has become the auditory signature of Zelda for a generation of gamers who grew up with **Breath of the Wild** and **Tears of the Kingdom**. This connection is vital for the community, as the voice actor's performance directly influences how players connect with and perceive the princess. Summersett’s dedication ensures that Zelda remains a compelling and relatable figure, not just a silent icon.

## The Future of Hyrule's Princess

With **The Legend of Zelda** franchise continuing to captivate audiences worldwide, the anticipation for what comes next is always high. While details regarding future games and potential live-action adaptations remain under wraps, **Patricia Summersett**'s established role as the voice of Princess Zelda suggests her continued involvement. Her performance has cemented her place in the hearts of fans, and many are eager to hear her voice in whatever adventures Hyrule has in store.
